title: Marlowe Rewards Return-Abuse Screen and Membership Status Settings
content:
Marlowe Rewards uses the same return-abuse screen settings and the same status effects at every tier.

| Setting | Marlowe Rewards Member | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Icon | Atelier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Return-abuse rate threshold: trailing-12-month reversed spend as a percentage of qualifying spend, at or above which the screen fires | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Minimum number of distinct earning orders in the trailing 12 months before the screen can fire | 8 | 8 | 8 | 8 | 8 | 8 |
| Calendar months in the return-abuse look-back window | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| A positive points balance is forfeited when the membership closes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Conversion, bonuses and tier changes are withheld while the membership is suspended | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the settings (hypothetical figures)

| Reversed-to-qualifying percentage | Distinct earning orders in the window | Both settings met? |
|---|---|---|
| 60.0 | 8 | Yes, both figures are reached |
| 59.9 | 12 | No, the percentage is below 60 |
| 75.0 | 7 | No, there are fewer than 8 orders |

The 60 percent figure is met at 60 percent and above. The order figure is met at 8 distinct earning orders and above.
